answer.reason: The verses tell of Kiriathaim being built by Reuben and of the LORD's word that it would be taken.

clauses.english: was built by the children of Reuben
clauses.quote: the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim

clauses.english: was declared by the LORD to be confounded and taken

doubts: 1CH 6:76 names a Kirjathaim in Naphtali, a different place, and was left out.
GEN 14:5 speaks of Shaveh Kiriathaim, a plain where the Emims were smitten; it may not be this city, so it was left out.
JOS 13:19 and EZK 25:9 only list the city, so they were not used.
